name: Distributed Hierarchical Cache System
aliases: Distributed Shared-Memory Data Management with Multi-Level Cache
definition: A software-based distributed shared memory system for clusters that implements a global cache to avoid accessing local or remote mass storage during volume roaming. It allows data sharing between rendering nodes through fast interconnection networks.
summary: The Distributed Hierarchical Cache System is a software-based distributed shared memory mechanism that enables out-of-core volume roaming on rendering clusters by using a global cache spanning graphics memory, RAM, network, and disk.
